verification_notes: Verified locally over HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:8799/public/artifacts/bake-sale-margin-gemini-step-7.html on 2026-06-05 UTC. Final artifact rendered nonblank; accepted two ingredient rows for Flour and Chocolate chips; calculated cost per item /bin/zsh.28, margin 81.4%, break-even 37 packs, and batch profit .32 for a .50 target price. Changing target price to /bin/zsh.20 produced negative margin/profit and break-even 0; changing it to .00 raised margin to 86.1%, break-even to 27, and batch profit to .32. Reload restored product, yield, packaging, target price, goal, and both ingredient rows with names/prices/sizes/used amounts. Copy Summary wrote the expected plain-text summary to clipboard. Export File and Print controls are present; export/download code and print media styling were verified statically and the export click caused no console errors, but the Chrome automation did not observe a download event. Desktop layout had no horizontal overflow; a true mobile iframe viewport check was blocked by Chrome URL policy, so mobile fit was limited to static responsive-style inspection.

steps.response_summary: Gemini returned the first complete one-file bake-sale margin calculator with total ingredient cost, yield, packaging, price, profit, and margin.
